summary: PZZA is an honest disclosure issuer with a deteriorating but transparently disclosed operating story. The forensic profile is mostly clean: Big-4 auditor (EY, 5y), no going-concern flag, no covenant amendments, 200+ bps of leverage cushion, no auditor or CFO drama, no late filings. The drawdown is driven by (a) total system comp -0.1% in FY23 then -2.0% in Q1'24 with every segment negative, (b) UK acquisition round-trip (acquired 118 units, closing 43 within 9 months), (c) Middle East boycott drag on International comp, (d) buyback-by-debt capital structure that produced $461.9M stockholders' deficit and is now mid-pivot (Q1'24 buybacks=$0), (e) raised dividend ($0.42->$0.46) at 105% Q1 payout ratio that is functionally uncovered. The lone SEVERE finding is the equity-destruction-via-debt-funded-buybacks pattern. Claim-evolution check (Q1'24 vs 10-K) invalidates the +3.4% Domestic Co-owned bull narrative within 70 days of filing. This is a NEUTRAL-to-mild-SHORT name on the framework — not a 'liar' (which would mean exclude from longs and flag for shorts), more a 'forthcoming about a bad business'.
